The '''IG-106 assassin droid''' was a model of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] line of the [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]]. It resembled the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88 assassin droid]] line and featured a [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] mounted on its right arm.<ref name="SWG:ToOW" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] acquired a storage device containing a holographic image of an IG-106 droid, which he could use with a [[Multispectrum disguise suite|holoshroud]] to disguise himself as an IG-106 droid.<ref name="SWG:C6">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild</ref>

Several IG-106 units were also used as [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] by a [[Lok slicers|group of slicers]] on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] to guard [[Slicer House|their building]].<ref name="SWG:GttSH" />

==Behind the scenes==
IG-106 assassin droids were [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player characters]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ToOW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> IG-106 assassin droids were added to the game with the expansion ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]'', released on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:ToOW" />

With the release of the [[:w:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]] on [[May 22]], [[2007]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref> players could also buy an [[:w:c:swg:IG-106 costume|IG-106]] [[:w:c:swg:Costume|costume]] from [[:w:c:swg:Storytelling|Storyteller]] vendors for 25,000 credits. The costume could then be used with a holoshroud to give the player the appearance of an IG-106 droid for a limited time.<ref name="SWG:C6" />
